queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT family_id) AS total FROM member_schemes WHERE member_scheme_active = '1' AND noscheme = '0' AND app_version IN ('1')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT msa.family_id) AS total FROM member_schemes msa WHERE msa.member_scheme_active = '1' AND msa.sent_approve = '1' AND msa.sention_status = '0' AND msa.app_version IN ('1') AND msa.family_id NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT ms.family_id FROM member_schemes ms WHERE ms.member_scheme_active = '1' AND ms.sent_approve = '1' AND ms.sention_status = '1' )

SELECT SUM(total) AS total FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM tbl_mela_schedule_agewise_rec_new UNION SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM march_mela_schedule_eligible_famlies UNION SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM june_mela_families_scheduled UNION SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM mela_phase_4_eligible_families ) AS t

SELECT SUM(Applicationsunattended) AS totalunatt FROM ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.family_id) AS Applicationsunattended FROM ( SELECT ms.family_id, ms.member_id, ms.district_id, ms.reject_status, ms.app_version FROM member_schemes ms WHERE ms.family_id NOT IN ( SELECT ms2.family_id FROM member_schemes ms2 WHERE ms2.member_scheme_active = '1' AND ms2.noscheme = '0' AND ( ms2.reject_status = '1' OR ms2.sent_approve = '1' ) ) AND ms.member_scheme_active = '1' AND ms.noscheme = '0' ) t INNER JOIN district d ON t.district_id = d.id WHERE t.reject_status = '0' AND t.app_version = 1 GROUP BY d.dist_name ) AS result

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ms.family_id) AS total FROM member_schemes ms WHERE ms.family_id NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT dms.family_id FROM member_schemes dms WHERE dms.noscheme = '0' AND dms.member_scheme_active = '1' ) AND ms.member_scheme_active = '1' AND ms.noscheme = '1'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ms.family_id) AS total FROM member_schemes ms WHERE ms.member_scheme_active = '1' AND ( ms.sention_status = '1' OR ( (ms.reject_status IN ('1','2') AND ms.radiobuttonStatus = '5' AND ms.forwarded_to_bank IS NOT NULL) OR (ms.reject_status = '2' AND ms.radiobuttonStatus IS NULL) OR (ms.reject_status = '1' AND ms.radiobuttonStatus IS NULL AND ms.forwarded_to_bank IS NOT NULL) ) ) AND ms.app_version = 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ms.family_id) AS total FROM member_schemes ms WHERE ms.family_id NOT IN ( SELECT ms2.family_id FROM member_schemes ms2 WHERE ms2.member_scheme_active = '1' AND ms2.reject_status = '0' AND ms2.noscheme = '0' AND ( ms2.sention_status = '1' OR ms2.sent_approve = '1' ) ) AND ms.member_scheme_active = '1' AND ms.reject_status = 1 AND ms.noscheme = '0' AND ms.app_version = 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ms.family_id) AS total FROM member_schemes ms WHERE ms.family_id NOT IN ( SELECT ms2.family_id FROM member_schemes ms2 WHERE ms2.member_scheme_active = '1' AND ms2.reject_status = '0' AND ms2.noscheme = '0' AND ( ms2.sention_status = '1' OR ms2.sent_approve = '1' ) ) AND ms.member_scheme_active = '1' AND ( (ms.reject_status IN ('2') -- AND ms.rejected_after_approved = '0' AND ms.radiobuttonStatus IS NULL) OR ms.radiobuttonStatus IN ('10','11') ) AND ms.noscheme = '0' AND ms.app_version = 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ms.family_id) AS total FROM member_schemes ms WHERE ms.family_id NOT IN ( SELECT ms2.family_id FROM member_schemes ms2 WHERE ms2.member_scheme_active = '1' AND ms2.reject_status = '0' AND ms2.noscheme = '0' AND ( ms2.sention_status = '1' OR ms2.sent_approve = '1' ) ) AND ms.member_scheme_active = '1' AND ms.reject_status = 3 AND ms.noscheme = '0' AND ms.app_version = 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ms.family_id) AS total FROM member_schemes ms WHERE ms.member_scheme_active = '1' AND ms.reject_status = '1' AND ms.radiobuttonStatus = '5'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ms.family_id) AS total FROM member_schemes ms WHERE ms.member_scheme_active = '1' AND ms.sent_approve = '1' AND ms.sention_status = '1' AND ms.radiobuttonStatus IN ('2', '9')

SELECT COUNT(ms.family_id) AS total FROM member_schemes ms WHERE ms.newschm_id = '69' AND ms.newdepart_id = '13' AND ms.member_scheme_active = '1' AND ms.sent_approve = '1' AND ms.radiobuttonStatus = '9' AND ms.sention_status = '1' AND ms.noscheme = '0'
